#![allow(dead_code)]
//! The steps of the `greet` feature.

use cucumber::{given, then, when};

use super::Behavior;

#[given("an accepted input")]
fn accepted(world: &mut Behavior) {
    let _ = world;
}

#[when(expr = "greet runs on {string}")]
fn runs(world: &mut Behavior, name: String) {
    let _ = (world, name);
}

#[then("it is accepted")]
fn is_accepted(world: &mut Behavior) {
    let _ = world;
}
